COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPSS No.1485 of 2026
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Vinay Kumar, learned counsel for 
petitioner.
2. Mr. Sushil Vashisth, learned Standing 
Counsel for the State of Uttarakhand/ 
respondent Nos.1 to 3 .
3. Mr. Shailendra Nauriyal, learned counsel 
for respondent No.4/Selecting Body. 
4. Petitioner has challenged the provisional 
recommendation list date 27.02.2026 alleging 
that there is wrong application of reservation 
by the Commission. He clarified it saying that 
candidates who belong to OBC category with 
higher merits are still OBC category 
candidates while candidates lesser in merit of 
the same category have been migrated to the 
open category. He submits that this is 
something which is completely against as to 
how the reservation is to be applied.
5. Issue notice to respondent Nos.5 & 6 
returnable within four weeks.
6. Steps to be taken within 03 days.
7. Learned counsel for respondent-Selecting 
Body prays for and is granted four weeks’ 
time to file counter affidavit.
8. At the request of learned counsel for 
petitioner, put up on 20.07.2026 along with 
WPSS No.683 of 2026.
9. Meanwhile, respondent Nos.5 and 6 may 
also file counter affidavit.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 09.06.2026
PN
